description.value: Tickleberry's is an Okanagan institution that has been scooping ice cream since 1990, offering 150 flavors alongside an in-house fudge factory where visitors can watch confections being made in real time. Beyond ice cream, the shop stocks chocolate-covered dried fruits, local crafts, and a broad gift selection, making it a natural and memorable rest stop on the Okanagan cycling corridor. A second location operates in Downtown Penticton.

address.value: Hwy 97, Main St., OK Falls, BC V0H 1R0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Tickleberry's is an active ice cream shop operating in Okanagan Falls (primary location on Hwy 97) and Downtown Penticton; the OSM coordinates (49.34°N, 119.57°W) match Okanagan Falls, not Penticton as the OSM community tag states. Phone (+1-250-497-8862) and email are confirmed via the website contact page, though neither appears in OSM tags. The ice cream menu explicitly lists a 'Vegan Peanut Butter Brownie' flavor; the website also references to-go dishes for cyclists in a hurry, supporting a takeout value. Bike parking, washrooms, and water refill are not mentioned anywhere on the site.
